crossRefs.note: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you…
in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…
Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to…
Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
“Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence…
But godliness with contentment is great gain.
For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that…
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

translations.web: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
translations.bsb: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
translations.kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
translations.asv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therein to be content.
